method.int8_fake_weights/int16_fake_weights: Per-matrix symmetric fake quantization followed by dequantization into float64 parameters.
method.float32_compute: Float32-rounded graph arithmetic and dot products.
method.int8_compute_activations/int16_compute_a: Inputs and weights quantized per input vector/output channel; integer dot products accumulate in int64 and dequantize outputs. Q/K/V, attention outputs, and feed-forward activations are quantized per vector.
method.int8_compact_checkpoint/int16_compact_ch: Decay tensors are stored as symmetric int8/int16 with a per-tensor scale; biases and normalization tensors remain float64. Conversion output reports maximum/mean quantization error and elapsed conversion time.
method.all_modes: Biases and normalization parameters stay float64; integer modes use float64 biases and normalization math.

memory_interpretation: int8/int16 compact checkpoints store decay tensors as packed integers; loading expands them back into float64 parameters, so file-size reduction is real but runtime parameter RAM is not reduced. Integer operations are still quantized on the fly.
timing_interpretation: Reduced modes use direct linear kernels while the float64 reference builds autodiff nodes; observed speed differences include this inference-path change and cannot be attributed only to numeric precision.
